I stayed here for 2 days and it was definitely a worthwhile stay. The rooms were clean and neat, service was good, and the interior and staircase designs looked great. Toilets were very clean, though one small discomfort was that there was no ventilation fan. Also, the hotel does not have a lift, so carrying luggage upstairs can be a little inconvenient.

The location is excellent – close to India Gate, in a rich area surrounded by big brand hotels and shops. I also tried the buffet breakfast (₹350 per person) which had a good variety of food.

Overall, it’s a comfortable and convenient stay with good value for money.
negative_snippets:
The location in Connaught Place is convenient, and the manager ultimately ensured I received a refund related to a third-party travel agent dispute.

However, during check-in I was introduced to an external “Tourist Information Centre” agent operating through or near the hotel. This led to a misrepresented tour booking and a serious refund dispute offsite involving verbal intimidation.

After this incident, multiple individuals outside the hotel appeared to know about my dispute, which made me concerned about privacy and safety. On my final day, I was anxious about leaving my luggage at the property and worried my belongings or passport might be withheld.

While the manager eventually assisted in resolving the financial issue, I strongly recommend that the hotel reconsider allowing third-party travel agents to solicit guests, as this situation significantly impacted my sense of safety as an international traveler.

I recently stayed at the Jukaso Down Town hotel with my parents, and unfortunately, the experience was profoundly disappointing, bordering on unacceptable.
🛏️ Room Quality and Condition
The room we were assigned was located in an area that appeared to be tucked under a staircase. The most immediate issue was the extremely low ceiling height, which I estimate was not even six feet. This unconventional and restrictive design made the room feel incredibly cramped and claustrophobic.
Pervasive Foul Odor: The entire room smelled distinctly like a bathroom, suggesting severe plumbing or ventilation issues.
Damp and Unpleasant: The room was also noticeably damp, which contributed further to a musty, unpleasant atmosphere.
Damaged Furniture: The furniture was in a state of disrepair, with several items appearing broken or heavily worn.
Overall Atmosphere: The combination of low ceilings, dampness, the foul smell, and poor furnishings gave the space a deeply negative ambiance, reminiscent of a cell rather than a comfortable hotel room. The "heritage" feeling was present only in the sense of brilliant neglect.
🧑‍💼 Staff and Service
The staff interaction was equally frustrating. The receptionist was notably rude and displayed a general lack of professionalism and courtesy. There was a palpable sense that the hotel management and staff were indifferent to the quality of our stay and the concerns we raised.
🌟 Conclusion
I would strongly caution prospective guests against choosing Jukaso Down Town. The poor condition of the accommodation—particularly the uniquely low-ceilinged room, the pervasive foul odor, and the state of the furnishings—coupled with the unhelpful and rude staff, made for a highly negative and uncomfortable stay.
